title: Count Pattern Occurrences
prompt:
**Tình huống.** Text s with |s| ≤ 1000000 and pattern p with |p| ≤ 100000, both over lowercase letters. Count how many times p occurs in s.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Check every starting position (|s|·|p| comparisons)

**B)** KMP prefix function over p + '#' + s

**C)** Digit DP over the string

**D)** Kruskal on the characters

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: |s| up to 10^6 demands linear time — the KMP prefix function reports every occurrence in O(|s| + |p|).
